summary: GitHub Copilot suggests code as you type in supported editors. It is a paid add-on (or free for students/open-source maintainers) and is opt-in — you must install the extension and enable it. Disabling it is a single toggle in editor settings.

steps.path: VS Code: Settings → Extensions → GitHub Copilot → uncheck 'Enable' (or click the Copilot icon in the status bar → Disable)
JetBrains: Settings → Tools → GitHub Copilot → uncheck 'Enable Copilot'
GitHub.com → Settings → Copilot → toggle off or cancel subscription

whyTheyDidIt: Copilot is a revenue stream for GitHub and a developer ecosystem lock-in for Microsoft.

sources.label: GitHub Docs — Configuring GitHub Copilot in your environment

alternatives.name: Continue.dev
alternatives.why: open-source AI coding assistant you control — local models, no telemetry
